_comment: Code-switch dictionary: Urdu-script spellings that Whisper produces for English words, mapped to their Latin-script form. Applied by src/postprocess/codeswitch.py after transcription. Keys are spellings OBSERVED IN REAL TRANSCRIPTS, not guessed -- the same English word often has several transliterations (both ڈیجٹل and ڈیجیٹل occur for 'digital' in this project's data), so guessing misses the real ones and invents ones that never occur.
_growing: Never edit by hand in bulk. Run scripts/harvest_codeswitch.py to propose candidates, review them, then scripts/apply_codeswitch_candidates.py to merge. A wrong entry silently corrupts every future transcript; a missing one merely leaves a word untranslated.
_protected_note: Words in `protected` are never converted. They are English-origin but fully naturalized into written Urdu -- converting them makes the text read worse. منٹ alone appeared 19 times in one 35-minute lecture; rendering that as 'minute' mid-sentence would be wrong, not right.
